findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Mul.lean:35–40 defines `ContinuousLinearMap.mul` under exactly these nonunital, generic-scalar assumptions; the commutator definition only subtracts this map and its flip. Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/OfAssociative.lean:370 states `LieAlgebra.ad_eq_lmul_left_sub_lmul_right` for a general scalar algebra.
findings.fix: Parameterize the three declarations by `[NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]`; define the commutator and its application theorem under `[NonUnitalSeminormedRing R] [NormedSpace 𝕜 R] [IsScalarTower 𝕜 R R] [SMulCommClass 𝕜 R R]`, and use `[SeminormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra 𝕜 R]` for the adjoint identification. Specialize to ℝ in the exponential section.
findings.issue: `continuousCommutator` and `continuousCommutator_apply` unnecessarily require a unital real algebra; `continuousCommutator_toLinearMap` unnecessarily fixes the scalar field to ℝ. This excludes compatible complex algebras and, for the first two declarations, nonunital algebras.

summary: The multiplication helpers have natural assumptions, but the continuous commutator API retains unnecessary scalar and unit restrictions.
